description: This Java class 'PersistedServiceJob' extends 'GenericServiceJob' and manages the lifecycle of persisted service jobs within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles job queuing, initialization, recurrence scheduling, failure retries, and context retrieval, with job data stored in the 'JobSandbox' entity.

classes.name: PersistedServiceJob
classes.description: A class managing persisted service jobs, including scheduling, retries, recurrence, and context management within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: PersistedServiceJob
methods.description: Constructor initializing a persisted service job with scheduling and retry parameters.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Queues the job for execution, updating its status and ensuring it is available.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the job, setting start time, status, and configuring recurrence if applicable.

methods.name: createRecurrence
methods.description: Creates a recurrence of the job at the specified next time, handling scheduling.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks the job as finished, recording result and completion time.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Handles job failure, including retry logic and status update.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Retrieves the service name associated with the job.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves the execution context for the job, including runtime data and user login.

methods.name: getRetries
methods.description: Calculates the number of retries for the job based on failure count.

methods.name: canRetry
methods.description: Determines if the job can be retried based on maxRetry and currentRetryCount.

methods.name: getRecurrenceInfo
methods.description: Fetches recurrence information related to the job.

methods.name: deQueue
methods.description: Removes the job from the queue, resetting its state.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the scheduled start time of the job.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the job, defaulting if not set.
